name: String shapes job watcher
command: while :; do S=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8329/api/jobs | python3 -c "import json,sys; js=json.load(sys.stdin); j=[x for x in js if x['kind']=='shapes' and x['detail']=='java.lang.String']; print(j[0]['state'] if j else 'none')"); case "$S" in done|failed|cancelled|none) echo "terminal: $S"; break;; esac; ping -c 1 -W 10 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:8329/api/dumps/run-jfr-38/shapes?class=java.lang.String" | head -c 300
description: Wait for the String shapes job and fetch the payload
